name: python_manager
role: Manages Python virtual environments, package installation, and sys.path orchestration with a three-tier config system.

inputs.note: No inputs. Configured through parameter panel and exposes promoted methods to other operators.

outputs.note: One output, but primarily a configuration utility — not a data pipeline operator

setup_optional.why: Package manager: 'uv' (fast, auto-downloads Python) or 'pip' (standard, uses system Python)
Directory where the venv is created. A folder picker opens if pulsing Createvenv without this set.
Python version for UV backend. UV auto-downloads the requested version.
Toggle the venv's site-packages into TouchDesigner's sys.path for import access
Where to save new env registrations: 'user' (machine-wide), 'folder' (portable .lops/), or 'project' (embedded in .toe)
Show the console window during pip/uv operations

gotchas: Most users do not need this operator — ChatTD includes a built-in Python Manager for all LOPs dependencies
Only place this when you need a separate venv, isolated environment, or manual multi-env control
UV backend requires 'uv' in system PATH — operator prompts to switch to pip if not found
Environments page sequence is display-only and rebuilt from JSON config — editing rows directly does nothing
Environments marked 'STALE' have paths that no longer exist on disk — recreate or update path via Edit Config File
Three-tier priority: Project (.toe) > Folder (.lops/) > User (AppData) — higher tier wins on name collision
